reportDigest.description: sha256 of the gate's full JSON report, stored alongside the artifact.

description: A release is a complete, certified closure of the runtime represented by a specific source revision. This artifact is the machine-readable record of that certification. Timestamp is provenance only, never release identity. Two provenance chains are kept distinct: ping-runtime (the PING app source repo, e.g. ngesk2/crx-runtime) and agent-ops (the agent-operations workspace repo). A release artifact always names its chain.

baseline.description: The certified baseline: the source revision the currently healthy deployment was proven against. Rollback target of record.

deploymentPhase.description: Post-build gates, executed by the deploy lane on the target plane. NOT_RUN in a pre-promotion artifact; a second artifact (same schema, deploymentPhase filled) is emitted after the runtime proof.

provenance.description: Build-time provenance, recorded as a deployment requirement (Phase 9). Design only in this lane; the deployment agent implements it. Gap it closes: the certified baseline image was built from a non-git snapshot tarball with no OCI/git labels, so its source SHA had to be reconstructed by forensics afterward.

buildInfoExposed.description: True when /health or a build-info surface exposes non-secret source_sha / image identity / runtime version.

capturedAtBuild.description: True when source SHA/branch/repository were captured at image build time. False for forensically reconstructed provenance.

manifestDigest.description: sha256 over the canonical sorted path->content-digest manifest of the snapshot (node_modules/.git excluded).

digest.description: sha256 of the snapshot package-lock.json when present; otherwise 'absent'.

eventIdentity.description: Declared versions are source truth; certificationStatus is the derived claim. Never conflate them.

prePromotionGates.description: One entry per gate in sequence order. status: PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT_RUN.

schemaState.description: Schema version/state and the migration set with per-statement digests (reused from the migration/trigger gate scan).

confidence.description: HIGH = captured at build/certification time from git. MEDIUM/LOW = reconstructed by forensics afterward (the gap this artifact closes going forward).

dirty.description: True if the worktree had uncommitted changes; a release must be a specific revision, so dirty fails certification.

provenanceChain.description: ping-runtime = the PING app source repo. agent-ops = the agent-operations workspace repo. The two chains are never mixed.

repository.description: Source remote (e.g. ngesk2/crx-runtime). Recorded as observed; never guessed.

testManifest.description: Test evidence referenced by the release. The certifier does not re-run the suite; it records what ran.

title: PING Release Certification Artifact
